name: John B. Raymond
bio: John B. Raymond, Dakota's delegate to Congress, passed through Medora in July 1884 and faced a stiff fight for renomination at the Pierre convention that September. The paper reported his wife's burial in February 1885 and, in January 1886, the death of "Hon. John B. Raymond of Fargo."
